visual_action: The video is a short showcase clip filmed at the White House grounds, featuring multiple heavily customized agricultural vehicles. Scene 1: Close low-angle shot of a gold/chrome-painted tractor (Fendt brand, visible later) parked on the White House driveway; an American flag is mounted on the tractor, a construction crane is visible in the background, and partially visible etched/engraved rear-window art shows the U.S. Capitol dome with the text "Proudly [made?] in [USA?]". Scene 2: Close-up of a Case IH Magnum 265 tractor painted in a patriotic red, white, and blue American-flag livery with red-rimmed wheels. Scene 3: Wide upward-angle shot of the gold Fendt tractor with an American flag mounted on it in the foreground and the large U.S. flag on the White House flagpole in the background; the crane is visible again. Scene 4: Close-up of the gold Fendt tractor's hood/body panel bearing multiple autograph signatures in black marker, including legible names such as "Marty Makary 2025," "S. Rollb SCHMD 2025," "Olivia Wright USA!," and a large cursive signature reading "Hope [?] America"; the word "FENDT" is clearly visible on the tractor body. Scene 5: A man in a dark suit (seen from behind/side, face partially visible) signing the side of a large green John Deere S780 combine harvester; a blonde woman stands nearby watching; this appears to be an outdoor farm setting. Scene 6: A dark title card overlay on a dimmed image of the White House portico reads "THE WHITE HOUSE" in white serif text with a decorative emblem above it — serving as a branding/outro card.
